trigger: An archive passes checksum, CRC, manifest and runtime checks while task-required semantic roles may never have entered the selected output.
assertions: expectedInventory is fixed before packaging and independently of output traversal
observed roles use INCLUDED_VERIFIED, VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, KNOWN_NOT_INCLUDED, MISSING, or UNKNOWN
a self-generated archive manifest proves integrity only for selected contents
file count and byte count cannot overrule a missing required semantic role
KNOWN_NOT_INCLUDED remains an explicit exclusion and cannot become delivered by wording
external delivery counts only when authorized, retrievable, identity-verified, and receipt-bound
archive integrity, runtime, contract completeness, and user acceptance remain separate states
